presentation.description: Passionate about technology since my teenage years, I specialize in frontend development, with a strong focus on React and JavaScript. I work as a software engineer, designing scalable and high-performance interfaces with a strong emphasis on clean architecture and user experience. I have notably worked on projects related to energy consumption monitoring and optimization, but my interests extend more broadly to building robust, well-crafted digital products across a wide range of domains.

skills.gitUsedInEveryProject: Git is used in every project

egreen.title: Software Research & Development Engineer
egreen.description: Development and evolution of a SaaS platform for monitoring energy performance in tertiary buildings, with a strong focus on data visualization, regulatory compliance, and user experience.
achievements: Design and development of complex frontend interfaces in React (hooks, functional components, state management).
Implementation of dynamic dashboards for monitoring energy consumption and regulatory indicators (Tertiary Decree).
Refactoring and optimization of existing components to improve performance, maintainability, and code readability.
Integration of charts and data visualizations (charts, advanced filters, user interactions).
Close collaboration with backend, product, and design teams in an agile environment.
Contribution to frontend architecture decisions and development best practices.

dled.title: Frontend Developer — Personal Side Project
dled.description: Creation of a showcase website and portfolio, built end-to-end with a modern frontend approach, with a planned evolution toward an e-commerce platform.
achievements: Design and development of a responsive and accessible web interface.
Use of modern frontend technologies (React, Tailwind CSS) and deployment via GitHub Pages.
Structuring of source code and workflow via GitHub, with version control.
Integration of dynamic content and performance optimization for a smooth experience.
Preparation of the frontend architecture for future e-commerce integration via Shopify.
Independent project management, experimenting with new libraries and development methods.
